premise: What if you woke up as the God-Emperor of a galaxy-wide empire?
title:
WHAT IF YOU RULED
THE GALAXY?

lines.text: What if you woke up tomorrow as the God-Emperor of the whole galaxy?
Golden armour. A throne as tall as a mountain.
And a trillion subjects, kneeling, all at once.
Our galaxy has about one hundred billion stars. Imagine every single one is yours.

facts.claim: NASA estimates the Milky Way has approximately 100 billion stars.
facts.quote: the Milky Way is made up of approximately 100 billion stars

lines.text: Star fleets wait for your command.
And everyone wants something. Wars to end. Prayers to answer. Paperwork. So much paperwork.
So you try one normal thing. You order a sandwich.
Tiny problem. Your galaxy is a hundred thousand light years wide, and the kitchen is on the other side.

facts.claim: The Milky Way's disk is about 100,000 light years in diameter.

lines.text: Your sandwich is on its way.
